title: Supply, Installation, Testing and commissioning of fire alarm system for Conference hall at Deep Bhavan Office, Chennai
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of a 2-zone conventional fire alarm system for the conference hall at Deep Bhavan office of the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Deep Bhavan Office, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai 600001 (conference hall)

scope.item: Supply of 2 Zone Fire Alarm Conventional Panel, UL approval, reputed make
Supply of smoke detector, reputed make
Supply of flash hooter, reputed make
Supply of 1.5 sq.mm x 2 core armoured cable, reputed make
Supply of manual call point, reputed make
Supply of left and right bends, reputed make
Supply of 12 V, 7 AH battery, reputed make
Labour charges for installation, testing, fixing, laying and commissioning of fire alarm system including fittings, fastening accessories, rental of special machines, tools and tackles

money.notes: No estimate or EMD printed. 100% payment after successful installation and satisfactory working; final account bill on measured quantities; no escalation.

period.completion: 20 days from date of work order

eligibility: Reputed firms or authorised dealers/agents; credentials and descriptive brochures to accompany quotation
specs: 2-zone conventional fire alarm panel with UL approval; smoke detectors; flash hooters; manual call points; 1.5 sq.mm 2-core armoured cable; 12 V 7 Ah batteries; items to BIS where applicable
notes: Scanned NIQ: notice, Annexure A schedule (rates blank), Annexure B terms. Quotations due 25.04.2024 15:00, opened 16:00 same day. Notice specifies the conference hall, while the listing title says only 'Deep Bhavan Office'.
